title: #3251's CI debt step does not run hooks/test_guard.py a second time beside the checks-guard shards
why: Finding (the #3251 lane via the coordinator 21:20 CST Nov 14; the coordinator did not read it, triage read no code or workflow; n=1): #3251's CI debt step runs test_guard.py inside the checks job beside the checks-guard shards, so CI runs the suite twice for the same tree. Harm: a repeat run for the same change, which the owner's 20:17 goal (ruling own-goal-max-efficiency-accurate-fast) calls waste; rule roles-each-layer-proves-once. Fix (the lane's, two ways): the step reads the shard jobs' result through `needs`, or the Retire line names the shard. Red then green. Start it after #3251 merges.
